theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pwl_fderiv_weak_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : NNReal) (us : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ) (u : Euclid d → ℝ) (Φ : Euclid d → Euclid d), (∀ k, LipschitzWith K (us k)) → TendstoUniformly us u atTop → Integrable Φ → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, fderiv ℝ (us k) y (Φ y)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, fderiv ℝ u y (Φ y)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
